reserveReview.rationale: At Somnia block 439069606 (0x716403bfe03e376c5ccebe2421103e0defcf068386a4a60fb17ff454719dc15f; 2026-10-15T10:43:10Z), child totalSupply(), custodian totalAssets(), brandedCoinMinted() and the actual frxUSD balance each equaled 3,547,660.062648 tokens. Both asset() and custodianTkn() identify Somnia frxUSD 0x00000000d61733e7a393a10a5b48c311abe8f1e5. previewRedeem(1e18)=1e18, mintFee()=0, redeemFee()=0 and isolatedBackingEnabled()=false. This verifies immediate parent-token custody and the complete authored local child supply at one block, not upstream fiat reserves, independent financial assurance or an executed redemption. The terms name Frax Inc. and/or affiliates as issuer and give the Somnia website operator no redemption obligation. Round r2 verified twenty additional exact USDso deployments with 18 decimals, each mapped by the official factory to the same chain-local custodian address. On every additional chain, totalSupply, totalAssets, brandedCoinMinted and actual local frxUSD custody reconcile at the chain-specific block and timestamp listed in sources; asset() identifies that chain's frxUSD. Ethereum, Fraxtal, Arbitrum, Avalanche and Base have positive local supply; the remaining new deployments were observed with explicit zero supply and zero custody, not treated as unavailable. Retrieved verified token, factory and custodian implementations match pinned runtimes across all twenty-one reviewed chains. These are separate local custody/accounting observations, not a synchronized global or in-flight liability reconciliation, independent financial assurance or an executed exit. Unichain at block 61321808 (2026-10-15T13:16:07Z) is also verified: exact USDso identity and native factory mapping, source-matched implementations, distinct three-of-six Safe, zero supply/totalAssets/brandedCoinMinted and an explicit zero actual local frxUSD balance read from 0x80eede496655fb9047dd39d9f418d5483ed600df. Earlier exclusion based on an exploratory empty-code observation was incorrect; the saved pinned code and independent Dwellir re-verification supersede it.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Immediate frxUSD parent-token custody on twenty-one exact reviewed native deployments, with a separate block/timestamp per chain; no global or in-flight liability closure
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Immediate backing on each reviewed deployment is frxUSD. Complete global and in-flight liability coverage, uncatalogued integrations, upstream legal segregation, custodian allocation, independent financial reconciliation and holder seniority remain unestablished; zero unknown immediate asset-class exposure is not zero whole-product custody uncertainty.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The twenty-one reviewed deployments identify local frxUSD custody and chain-specific controlling Safes. No provider percentage is assigned to the whole product from asynchronous local balances. Global/in-flight liability closure, uncatalogued integrations, upstream legal segregation, independent financial reconciliation and holder seniority remain unestablished. On every reviewed chain the custodian owner is the factory proxy; source-matched current factory code has no generic recovery forwarder. Token/factory ProxyAdmins and custodian beacons are controlled by a three-of-five Safe on Ethereum and separate three-of-six Safes on the other reviewed chains. Custodian recoverERC20 has no reserve-token exclusion, and privileged replacement of factory or custody code remains possible.
